def rle(s):
    out = ''
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        j = i
        while j < len(s) and s[j] == s[i]:
            j += 1
        out += s[i] + str(j - i)
        i = j
    return out
```

def dedupe(items):
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for x in items:
        if x not in seen:
            seen.add(x)
            out.append(x)
    return out
```
